answer: Identity = hash(pubkey || burn_tx) where burn_tx destroys 100 POA. Each epoch, identities must burn additional 50 to stay active. Attacker creating N identities burns N × 100 upfront + N × 50 per epoch, cost compounding. System verifies via burn transaction receipts on Base; duplicate detection via nullifier set. Voting power = log(1 + total_burned). Threshold 90 POA burned for eligibility. Words: meadow, grove, prism.
